# `∘` — Atop

Keys: `Alt-t`

`f∘g Y` is `f(g Y)`, and `X f∘g Y` is `f(X g Y)`.

```bpl
2 -∘+ 3            ⍝ ¯5
```
See [Rank](rank.qmd) for applying a function to cells of a chosen rank.

## Inverse

`(f∘g)⁻¹` applies `f⁻¹`, then inverts `g`. With an argument fixed, it inverts `g` with that argument fixed.

```bpl
(-∘÷)⁻¹ ¯0.5   ⍝ 2
```
